# Project and misc

There are a few segments that can be included at the top of the yml file.

## Project

The type of project (i.e. is it a website, book, etc.)

For a normal quarto website you can have the following.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
project:
  type: website
```

::: {.callout-tip}
Note that the top line of a segment (i.e. `project:`) has no indentation.
Then all lines in that segment have at least one level of indentations (e.g. `type:website` has one level).
:::

You can also create:

- [Books](https://quarto.org/docs/reference/projects/books.html)
- [Manuscripts](https://quarto.org/docs/reference/projects/manuscripts.html)
- [Presentations](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/)

There are also other [Project options](https://quarto.org/docs/reference/projects/options.html) than just `type:`.
For example you can set the output director with `output-dir:`.

## Editor

Editor options.
We set this part to try to ensure our preview updates when we save.

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
editor:
  render-on-save: true
```

## Knitr

Try to force the use of knitr.

```{bash,eval=FALSE}
knitr: true
```
